name: ugc-zero
description: uGC, the never-collecting GC, in place of the built-in clrgc

objects.note: uGC v1.0.7+: the C++ wrappers delegate to the formally verified C core, shipped as separate objects.

options.note: dotnet-riscv fixup perf-83: uGC never collects, so no stack is ever scanned, and zeroing a slot only because it holds GC references is dead work. localsinit and read-before-write zeroing stay.
